# temps_kv_settings (Resource)

Name of the container Temps runs the built-in key-value service in. Temps refuses a change while the container is in use; set it before `temps_kv`.

Destroying the resource leaves the name as it is; it only stops managing it.

Import with `kv_settings`.

Required API key permissions: `kv:read`, `kv:write`, `system:admin`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_kv_settings" "this" {
  container_name = "temps-kv-main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container_name` (String) Container name; it must start with `required_prefix`.

### Read-Only

- `default_container_name` (String) Name used when none is set.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `kv_settings`.
- `in_use` (Boolean) Whether the container exists now.
- `required_prefix` (String) Prefix every name must have.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_kv_settings.this kv_settings
```
